summary_rationale: Chubb Limited is one of the highest-quality global property and casualty (P&C) underwriting franchises in existence, combining an A++ (AM Best) / AA (S&P) balance sheet with a multi-decade track record of sub-90% P&C combined ratios (85.7% in FY2025; 84.1% in Q3 2026) even after absorbing $2.92B in FY2025 catastrophe losses including $1.47B from the January 2025 Southern California wildfires. Its $168.7B investment portfolio (5.1% book yield, 5.5% market yield, 4.7–4.8 year duration) and $12.82B FY2025 operating cash flow power consistent 13.7% core operating ROE and 11%–15% annual growth in book value per share excluding AOCI ($201.31 at FY2025; $150.70 tangible ex-AOCI at Q3 2026). KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than an unconditional PASS because two structural cross-currents require active monitoring: (1) commercial property rate softening (-8% to -10%+) in 2025–2026 has led Chubb to defensively shrink large-account property and E&S volume, slowing consolidated NPW growth to +1.9% YoY in Q3 2026; and (2) U.S. casualty social inflation (6%–7% primary and 9.5%–12% excess loss-cost inflation) keeps prior-year reserve adequacy on 2019–2022 and unseasoned 2023+ accident years under constant scrutiny.
